next_step_recommendation: Close scale-prefix features as the next deployable route. Shift from flow-matching MSE to a conditional likelihood-trained transition law over the same generic state panel: fixed empirical-score preprocessing, one shared memory, one shared transition model, but optimize conditional density / NLL so calibration and probability mass are first-class rather than incidental.
